claim.claim-text: 1. An artificial intelligence-based system, comprising:

a comparator configured to: apply a position-wise deterministic comparison function to the reference output and the alternative output generated for bases in the reference sequence and the alternative sequence, and generate a position-wise comparison result based on differences, caused by the variant in the alternative sequence, between the signal levels of the reference output and the signal levels of the alternative output; and
a pathogenicity determiner that processes the position-wise comparison result and produces an output which scores the variant in the alternative sequence as pathogenic or benign.

2. The artificial intelligence-based system of claim 1, wherein the base is flanked by downstream and upstream context bases, and the variant of the base is flanked by the downstream and upstream context bases.
3. The artificial intelligence-based system of claim 1, wherein a length of the promoter sequence is from 200 to 20,000 bases, optionally wherein a length of the promoter sequence is 3001 bases.

4. The artificial intelligence-based system of claim 1, wherein a length of the promoter sequence is adapted to specific promoter sequences, optionally wherein the promoter sequence is centered at a transcription start site (TSS).

5. The artificial intelligence-based system of claim 1, wherein bases of the promoter sequence are one-hot encoded to conserve position-specific information for each individual base in the promoter sequence.

6. The artificial intelligence-based system of claim 1, wherein the plurality of epigenetic tracks comprise at least one of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) methylation changes, histone modifications, noncoding ribonucleic acid (ncRNA) expression, or chromatin structural changes, and/or wherein the plurality of epigenetic tracks comprise one or both of deoxyribonuclease (DNase) tracks or histone 3 lysine 27 acetylation (H3K27ac) tracks.
7. A processor-implemented method, comprising:

processing the reference sequence and generating a reference output, wherein the reference output specifies, for each base in the reference sequence, signal levels of a plurality of epigenetic tracks; and processing the alternative sequence and generating an alternative output, wherein the alternative output specifies, for each base in the alternative sequence, the signal levels of the plurality of epigenetic tracks, wherein the plurality of epigenetic tracks comprise at least one of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) methylation changes, histone modifications, noncoding ribonucleic acid (ncRNA) expression, or chromatin structural changes.
8. The processor-implemented method of claim 7, wherein the base is flanked by downstream and upstream context bases, and wherein the variant is flanked by the downstream and upstream context bases.

9. The processor-implemented method of claim 7, wherein the plurality of epigenetic tracks comprise one or both of deoxyribonuclease (DNase) tracks or histone 3 lysine 27 acetylation (H3K27ac) tracks.
10. The processor-implemented method of claim 7, further comprising:

applying a position-wise deterministic comparison function to the reference output and the alternative output generated for bases in the reference sequence and the alternative sequence; and generating a position-wise comparison result based on differences, caused by the variant in the alternative sequence, between the signal levels of the reference output and the signal levels of the alternative output, optionally wherein the method further comprises: processing the position-wise comparison result to generate an output which scores the variant in the alternative sequence as pathogenic or benign.
11. The processor-implemented method of claim 7, wherein:

a length of the promoter sequence is adapted to specific promoter sequences, optionally wherein the promoter sequence is centered at a transcription start site (TSS); and/or bases of the promoter sequence are one-hot encoded.
12. A non-transitory computer readable storage medium storing instructions executable by a processor to perform actions comprising:

processing the reference sequence and generating a reference output, wherein the reference output specifies, for each base in the reference sequence, signal levels of a plurality of epigenetic tracks; and processing the alternative sequence and generating an alternative output, wherein the alternative output specifies, for each base in the alternative sequence, the signal levels of the plurality of epigenetic tracks.

13. The non-transitory computer readable storage medium of claim 12, wherein the base is flanked by downstream and upstream context bases, and wherein the variant is flanked by the downstream and upstream context bases.
14. The non-transitory computer readable storage medium of claim 12, wherein the non-coding sequence comprises a promoter region.
15. The non-transitory computer readable storage medium of claim 12, wherein the actions further comprise:

applying a position-wise deterministic comparison function to the reference output and the alternative output generated for bases in the reference sequence and the alternative sequence; and generating a position-wise comparison result based on differences, caused by the variant in the alternative sequence, between the signal levels of the reference output and the signal levels of the alternative output, optionally wherein the actions further comprise: processing the position-wise comparison result to generate an output which scores the variant in the alternative sequence as pathogenic or benign.
